description: Fixed generation suite for TinyLM. Prompts are grouped by the behaviour they probe; 'expected' says what a good continuation does, so failures can be labelled consistently. Do not edit prompts in place: add new ids and bump the version.

prompts.expected: A complete, coherent short story.

prompts.expected: Coherent story centred on Lily.

prompts.prompt: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Rosie who lived in a yellow house near the sea. Rosie had a pet turtle called Shelly. Every morning, Rosie fed Shelly green leaves and told her about her dreams. One morning, Rosie saw that Shelly was not in her box. Rosie was very worried. She looked in the kitchen, but Shelly was not there. She looked in the garden, but Shelly was not there either. Rosie asked her grandpa for help. Grandpa put on his big hat and said, "Let's look by the sea." They walked down to the beach together. The sand was warm and the waves were small. Rosie saw many shells, but none of them moved. Then she saw a seagull standing very still on a rock. The seagull was looking at something in the water. Rosie ran to the rock and
prompts.expected: Keeps Rosie, Shelly (a turtle), grandpa and the beach setting consistent with ~200 tokens of context.
